# windows_domain_membership (Data Source)

Reads the current domain-membership state of the remote Windows host without managing it. This is a **singleton** data source — no lookup keys are required.

Exposes `part_of_domain`, the DNS `domain` (empty when workgroup-joined), the `workgroup` (empty when domain-joined), `computer_name`, `dns_host_name` (with `fqdn` as its alias), the NetBIOS `netbios_domain`, the `domain_role`, `pending_reboot`, the `secure_channel_ok` result (`null` when the host is not joined or when `check_secure_channel` is `false`), and the stable `machine_id` (HKLM MachineGuid).

The Terraform data source ID is the `machine_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Singleton — no lookup keys required.
data "windows_domain_membership" "current" {}

output "part_of_domain" {
  value = data.windows_domain_membership.current.part_of_domain
}

output "domain" {
  value = data.windows_domain_membership.current.domain
}

output "domain_role" {
  value = data.windows_domain_membership.current.domain_role
}

output "secure_channel_ok" {
  value = data.windows_domain_membership.current.secure_channel_ok
}

# Inventory-only read: skip the Test-ComputerSecureChannel probe
# (secure_channel_ok is then null).
data "windows_domain_membership" "inventory" {
  check_secure_channel = false
}

# Gate domain-dependent management on the observed join state.
resource "windows_local_group_member" "domain_admins" {
  count  = data.windows_domain_membership.current.part_of_domain ? 1 : 0
  group  = "Administrators"
  member = "CORP\\Domain Admins"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `check_secure_channel` (Boolean) Whether to probe the domain secure channel (Test-ComputerSecureChannel). Defaults to true when unset; set to false for inventory-only reads to avoid the domain-controller round-trip (secure_channel_ok is then null).
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `computer_name` (String) Active computer name (Win32_ComputerSystem.Name).
- `dns_host_name` (String) Fully qualified host name (Win32_ComputerSystem.DNSHostName).
- `domain` (String) DNS name of the joined domain. Empty when the host is workgroup-joined (never the workgroup name).
- `domain_role` (String) Win32_ComputerSystem.DomainRole mapped to its name: StandaloneWorkstation, MemberWorkstation, StandaloneServer, MemberServer, BackupDomainController or PrimaryDomainController.
- `fqdn` (String) Alias of dns_host_name.
- `id` (String) Data source ID; the stable machine ID (HKLM MachineGuid).
- `netbios_domain` (String) NetBIOS (short) domain name. Empty when the host is workgroup-joined.
- `part_of_domain` (Boolean) True when the host is joined to an Active Directory domain.
- `pending_reboot` (Boolean) True when the OS exposes a pending reboot flag.
- `secure_channel_ok` (Boolean) Test-ComputerSecureChannel result. Null when the host is workgroup-joined or when check_secure_channel is false.
- `workgroup` (String) Workgroup name. Empty when the host is domain-joined.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
